name: bala-perdida
description: Monorepo de Bala Perdida (Cliente React + PixiJS v8 y Servidor Colyseus + Matter.js)

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.dev: bash -c 'trap "kill 0" EXIT INT TERM; npm --prefix server run dev & npm --prefix client run dev & wait'
scripts.build: npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix client run build
